instruction: A candid full-shot photograph captured from a low angle depicts an outdoor acrobatic stunt against a clear blue sky. Standing upright on a light-brown stone block, the man in the black t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) supports the woman in the black crop top and denim shorts (R1) on his shoulders. The woman stands balanced, holding his raised left hand with her left hand while her right arm hangs freely. Her eyes are closed in concentration, while the man looks forward with a determined expression. The scene is bathed in bright, direct daylight, highlighting the vibrant blue sky and the warm texture of the stone.
